lessonTitle: 37. Volumes of parts of a ball
lessonTitleEnglish: Volumes of parts of a ball
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Volumes of solids
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A spherical segment (cap) of height h has volume V = πh²(R − h/3).
stages.headlineEnglish: A spherical segment (cap) of height h has volume V = πh²(R − h/3).

stages.headline: A spherical sector has volume V = (2/3)πR²h, where h is the height of its cap.
stages.headlineEnglish: A spherical sector has volume V = (2/3)πR²h, where h is the height of its cap.

stages.headline: Example: R = 5, h = 2 give V(segment) = π · 4 · (5 − ⅔) = 52π/3.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: R = 5, h = 2 give V(segment) = π · 4 · (5 − ⅔) = 52π/3.
